name: AVCI_FINAL_TEST_PRIMARY_HYPOTHESIS_V1
primary_hypothesis: In BTC-DOWN episodes, frozen Avci candidates outperform same-scan matched controls on conditional-BTC-beta-residual, cost-stressed fixed-exit net return.
unit_of_inference: 72h overlapping market episode, not individual coin event
primary_comparison: candidate minus same-scan matched-control fixed-exit return
primary_adjustments: pre-signal conditional BTC beta residualization where data coverage is sufficient
primary_success_rule: Episode-cluster bootstrap 95% lower bound of matched candidate-control mean difference is greater than 0.
minimum_interpretability: matching coverage and covariate balance must be reported
no threshold or rule changes from FINAL_TEST outcomes
secondary_diagnostics: MFE and MAE normalized by realized volatility when available
candidate/control hit rates as descriptive only
non_goals: FINAL_TEST is not used to retune frozen v1/V5
MFE touch rate is not the primary success metric
Telegram scorecards are not selection criteria
